description: RootBackendProduct, NativeProgram, BackendExecutable, AbiExecutable, MaterializedExecutable, StructSchema become engine derivations. Retiring a root withdraws its demand and the engine releases what nothing demands. Failed is a producer outcome with FatalError's contract (pull.rs documents it so). Deletes ProductMemo readers/readiness/rooted membership witness, ProductMutationWave, PullSession scheduling, ProductSessions routing, DependencyKey::Product, product_drive.rs as a separate drive. Docs: fact-engine.md 'Product pulls for artifacts' folds into the engine sections; pipeline.md artifact path.
title: Artifacts are root-scoped engine derivations; the pull system is gone
